question: Five girls, Amita, Fauzia, Gargi, Ranjita and Sucheta, are sitting in a straight line. All are facing the north direction. Sucheta sits second to the left of Gargi. Fauzia sits third to the right of Sucheta. Only one girl is sitting between Amita and Ranjita. Amita is not sitting at any of the extreme ends. Which two girls are sitting at the extreme ends?
solution:
**Given**: Five girls, Amita, Fauzia, Gargi, Ranjita and Sucheta, are sitting in a straight line. All are facing the north direction.

Based on the given conditions, we get the following arrangement-

1. Only one girl is sitting between Amita and Ranjita. Amita is not sitting at any of the extreme ends. From these we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/142aae70df836af77b01a7e10007ff1351e203cadb72951750414ee553caed28.png] 

2. Sucheta sits second to the left of Gargi. Fauzia sits third to the right of Sucheta. From these, we get the final arrangement as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af007a40d37f6bc78ea84d100a0b005c517cdf3b3fbc047fdc3c71843c8a7e8a.png] 

Therefore, from the given final arrangement we see that Ranjita and Fauzia sit at the extreme ends of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
